questions.question: What do we say before eating?
questions.explanation: We say 'Bismillah' (In the name of Allah) before eating.

questions.question: What do we say after eating?
questions.explanation: We say 'Alhamdulillah' (All praise is due to Allah) after eating.

questions.question: What does 'As-salamu Alaykum' mean?
questions.explanation: 'As-salamu Alaykum' means 'Peace be upon you' and is the Islamic greeting.

questions.question: What do we say when we sneeze?
questions.explanation: We say 'Alhamdulillah' when we sneeze, thanking Allah.

questions.question: What do we say to someone who sneezes?
questions.explanation: We say 'Yarhamukallah' (May Allah have mercy on you) to someone who sneezes.

questions.question: What does 'InshaAllah' mean?
questions.explanation: 'InshaAllah' means 'If Allah wills' and is said when planning to do something.

questions.question: What does 'MashaAllah' mean?
questions.explanation: 'MashaAllah' means 'What Allah has willed' and is said to express appreciation.

questions.question: What do we say when entering the bathroom?
questions.explanation: We seek Allah's protection before entering the bathroom.

questions.question: What do we say when waking up?
questions.explanation: We thank Allah with 'Alhamdulillah' for waking us up.

questions.question: What does 'SubhanAllah' mean?
questions.explanation: 'SubhanAllah' means 'Glory be to Allah' and is said to praise Him.

questions.question: What does 'Alhamdulillah' mean?
questions.explanation: Alhamdulillah means 'All praise is for Allah'. We say it to thank Allah.

questions.question: What does 'Allahu Akbar' mean?
questions.explanation: Allahu Akbar means 'Allah is the Greatest'.

questions.question: What do we say when we plan to do something in the future?
questions.explanation: InshaAllah means 'If Allah wills'. We say it when talking about future plans.

questions.question: What do we say when we see something beautiful or amazing?
questions.explanation: MashaAllah means 'What Allah has willed'. We say it when we admire something.

questions.question: How do we reply when someone says 'As-salamu alaykum'?
questions.explanation: We reply 'Wa alaykum assalam', which means 'And peace be upon you too'.

questions.question: What do we say when we make a mistake and want Allah's forgiveness?
questions.explanation: Astaghfirullah means 'I seek forgiveness from Allah'.

questions.question: Which hand should we use to eat and drink?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught us to eat and drink with the right hand.

questions.question: When is it a good time to say 'SubhanAllah'?
questions.explanation: We can say SubhanAllah when we are amazed by Allah's beautiful creation.

questions.question: What should we say to someone who sneezes and says 'Alhamdulillah'?
questions.explanation: We reply 'Yarhamukallah', which means 'May Allah have mercy on you'.

questions.question: What do we say to thank someone in an Islamic way?
questions.explanation: Jazakallahu khayran means 'May Allah reward you with good'.

questions.question: Which foot should we enter the mosque with?
questions.explanation: We enter the mosque with the right foot and leave with the left foot.

questions.question: Which foot should we enter the bathroom with?
questions.explanation: We enter the bathroom with the left foot and leave with the right foot.

questions.question: When should we say 'Bismillah'?
questions.explanation: We say Bismillah (In the name of Allah) before starting any good action, like eating, drinking, or entering our home.

questions.question: What do we say when we hear that someone has died?
options: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
questions.explanation: It means 'To Allah we belong and to Him we shall return'.

questions.question: If we forget to say Bismillah before eating, what should we say when we remember?
questions.explanation: We say 'Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu' (In the name of Allah at its beginning and end).

questions.question: What dua do we make for our parents?
questions.explanation: This dua means 'My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small'.

questions.question: What is the dua for increasing knowledge?
questions.explanation: 'Rabbi zidni ilma' means 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge'.

questions.question: What do we say when getting into a car or on a bus (dua of travel)?
questions.explanation: The travel dua starts 'Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha' — Glory to the One who made this ready for us.

questions.question: What should we say when we wake up in the morning?
questions.explanation: When waking up we praise Allah who gave us life after sleep, and to Him is the return.

questions.question: What does 'La ilaha illallah' mean?
options: There is no god but Allah
questions.explanation: 'La ilaha illallah' means 'There is no god worthy of worship except Allah'. It is the heart of the Shahada.

questions.question: After prayer, many Muslims say SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar how many times?
questions.explanation: A common dhikr after prayer is 33 SubhanAllah, 33 Alhamdulillah, and 34 Allahu Akbar, making 100.

questions.question: What is the remembrance of Allah called?
questions.explanation: Dhikr means remembering Allah with words like SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, and Allahu Akbar.

questions.question: Which dua did Prophet Yunus say inside the whale?
options: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
questions.explanation: Prophet Yunus called out: 'There is no god but You, glory be to You, indeed I was among the wrongdoers.'

questions.question: What do we say when leaving the house, putting our trust in Allah?
questions.explanation: When leaving home we say 'Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallah' — In the name of Allah, I put my trust in Allah.

questions.question: Which two Surahs (with Al-Ikhlas) do many Muslims recite before sleeping for protection?
questions.explanation: Before sleeping, it is Sunnah to recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas.

questions.question: What is a personal prayer where we ask Allah for anything called?
questions.explanation: Dua is when we talk to Allah and ask Him for what we need, at any time.

questions.question: When someone says 'Jazakallahu khayran' to you, a good reply is:
questions.explanation: 'Wa iyyakum' means 'And to you as well', wishing them the same reward.

questions.question: What is the famous dua asking for good in this world and the next?
options: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah wa fil-akhirati hasanah
questions.explanation: This dua from the Quran asks Allah for good in this world, good in the Hereafter, and protection from the Fire.

questions.question: What does 'Tabarakallah' mean?
questions.explanation: Tabarakallah means 'Blessed is Allah', said when admiring something, like MashaAllah.

questions.question: On which day is it especially recommended to send salawat (blessings) on the Prophet?
questions.explanation: Friday is a special day for sending many salawat upon Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
